title: Parkinson's DAO: Shoreditch Commons
summary: A walkable urban commons around St Leonard's Church, Shoreditch, where James Parkinson described the shaking palsy in 1817. Six zones form an agent-managed DAO campus: charter, research, proposals, operations and progress, all anchored to the churchyard, Arnold Circus and Bishopsgate.

buildings.name: Charter Nave
buildings.use: DAO charter display and contribution model registry

props: bronze plaque of the 1817 essay on the shaking palsy

buildings.name: Synthesis Reading House
buildings.use: Evidence monitoring and literature synthesis workspace

buildings.name: Proposal Hall
buildings.use: Debate chamber for drafts pending human vote

buildings.name: Drafting Booth Row
buildings.use: Small booths where drafts are refined before debate

buildings.name: Collaborator Annex
buildings.use: Scouting desk for expert and partner mapping

buildings.name: Observation Bandstand
buildings.use: Open-air metrics review and progress tracking

buildings.name: Indicators Tower
buildings.use: Tall thin tower displaying charter outcome meters

court.name: The Shaking Palsy Court
court.style: Walled Georgian churchyard garden with a central bandstand
court.why_here: St Leonard's is James Parkinson's parish church; its churchyard is the natural court for a DAO bearing his name.

quests.title: Read the 1817 Essay
steps: Find the bronze plaque at Charter Hall
Retrieve the essay copy from the Vestry Records Office
Deliver it to the Evidence Board Room
Summarize three key observations for the stewards

quests.title: From Draft to Human Vote
steps: Collect a synthesis summary from the Reading House
Have the Proposal & Grant Drafter shape it into a draft
Post it on the Debate Floor
Wait respectfully for the human stewards' final vote

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Take the approved proposal outcome to the Operations Hub
Assign tasks on the magnetic routing board
Brief the Collaborator Scout on missing expertise
Confirm working-group rooms are scheduled

quests.title: Measure What Matters
steps: Gather completed task cards from the Operations Hub
Carry them to the Indicators Tower
Update the brass progress dials
Raise the milestone flag on the bandstand

quests.title: Full Cycle of Governance
steps: Begin at the Charter Wall
Trace one proposal through Lab, Forum and Deck
Verify outcomes at the Observatory
Record the cycle in the Contribution Ledger Room
Note which steps were reserved for humans
